fields.title: Prune duplicate project rows left by a path-resolution bug
fields.description: Prune duplicate project rows whose paths resolve to the same directory, refusing unless the duplicate is provably empty and re-pointing its references instead of orphaning them.
fields.context:
E-2002 stops the Go hook auto-registering a second project for a directory that already has one, and makes lookups tolerate rows stored unresolved — but it deliberately ships no migration, so a ledger that already caught the bug keeps its junk row (typically named <project>-2, path unresolved, zero tasks, bound to whatever sessions ran while the bug was live).

It is inert after E-2002 (lookups prefer the lower id) but still shows up in `endless project list` and in any per-project rollup.
fields.analysis: Consider whether this belongs in `endless project purge` or a doctor-style command.

fields.description: Notify a session when its task is landed, including from another terminal, since landing changes no watched task field and so triggers no notice today.

fields.title: Converge agent-change detection onto the recorded harness
fields.description: Converge on the harness recorded in each event to decide whether an agent made a task change, deleting the second, unpersisted check that reads an environment variable.
fields.notes: NOT the bug this task was originally filed as: that one was already fixed by 254aff3a, six hours before this task was filed.
fields.context:
tasks_notify_sessions decides 'did an agent make this change' from CLAUDECODE, read in the executing process by stampTaskActor, while the event envelope now records the same fact as Actor.Harness from internal/agentenv (E-2005).

Two answers to one question, which can disagree in both directions, and the one that decides suppression is ambient process state that is never persisted — so a notice that was dropped cannot be explained afterward.

fields.title: Refuse empty file arguments that would blank a field
fields.description: Refuse an empty file passed to a task or decision update file option, instead of silently replacing the existing description, plan, analysis or outcome with nothing.
